params.body:
An admission signed on the YubiKey (`hand.mjs admit`) named 11 kinds, while Portal's `Capability::WORKBENCH_KINDS` names 13. An admission from the YubiKey therefore did not cover `issue.open` or `portal.share`, while the same admission by passkey did.

- `WORKBENCH_KINDS` in `lib/hand.mjs` now holds the same 13 kinds as Portal.
- The comment no longer claims the list has been the same since September. It says the list is kept by hand until the gateway serves its kinds itself.

Safe for the gateway: it judges each action against the capability (`capability.go:120`) and against the grant (`policy.go:290`), so a capability that lists a kind the grant lacks gains nothing.

Tests: `lib/policy.test.mjs` 7 pass, `lib/admission.test.mjs` 9 pass.
